title: Mexican Smoked Fish Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this recipe combines smoky flavors with fresh ceviche and fish.
instructions: 1. Cut the fish into small pieces and season with smoked paprika and ceviche seasoning.
2. Mix together lime juice and light mayo, and brush the mixture onto the fish.
3. Refrigerate the fish for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
4. Meanwhile, toast the tortillas by grilling them for a few seconds on each side.
5. Assemble the tacos by placing the fish onto the tortillas, followed by sliced radishes and a dollop of sour cream.
6. Serve immediately, with lime wedges on the side.
8. Cook the fish to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
9. Make sure to handle the raw fish safely and cook it to a safe temperature to avoid foodborne illness.
10. Serve with your favorite toppings, such as diced onions or shredded cabbage.
